items.title: China's second typhoon in a week makes landfall
items.description: Nearly two million people are evacuated from eastern Zhejiang province, with the city of Wenzhou close to the path of the storm.

items.title: Iran supreme leader calls for revenge for father's killing
items.description: Mojtaba Khamenei says vengeance is "inevitable" for the killing, which happened on the first day of the US-Israeli war on Iran.

items.title: Spain battles to contain one of its deadliest wildfires as at least 12 killed
items.description: At least four Britons are believed to be among the victims of the blaze, which left another 23 people missing.

items.title: Trump administration subpoenas New York Times journalists over Air Force One reporting
items.description: The reporters received the legal summons after they reported on alleged security issues with the president's new plane, which was gifted by Qatar.

items.title: Polish PM pledges memorial to victims of WW2 'genocide by Ukrainian nationalists'
items.description: Warsaw and Kyiv have for decades been at loggerheads over the killings of many thousands of civilians during World War Two.

items.title: US Democrat Ro Khanna says he was detained by armed Israeli settlers
items.description: Khanna, 49, was visiting the occupied West Bank when he was held for 90 minutes, he says.

items.title: South Africa World Cup midfielder Adams dies aged 25
items.description: South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams dies at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup.

items.title: More than 40 kidnapped children and teachers freed after Nigerian army operation
items.description: "I feel happy and elated… I feel joy," the head of the local teachers' union tells the BBC.

items.title: Indian tourists among 15 killed as speedboat capsizes in Vietnam
items.description: Local media say 21 people were saved after the boat overturned in rough seas near an island in south Vietnam.

items.title: US pays out $3m to victims of mystery Havana Syndrome condition reported by spies
items.description: US officials and diplomats and their families began reporting a mysterious illness a decade ago.

items.title: Landmark US housing bill becomes law despite Trump protest
items.description: The president had wanted voter ID legislation passed before the housing law, which aims to reduce costs and increase supply.

items.title: New dinosaur species as long as cricket pitch discovered in Thailand
items.description: The plant-eating dinosaur, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, is thought to have lived about 150 million years ago.
